text:
maya: Heads up — PR #8821 (kv-cache hotfix) needs 2x LGTM before the 16:30 UTC cutoff (≈25m). CI green except one flaky smoke on macos-runner. Can we get eyeballs? :alarm_clock:

ashwin: On it, give me 10. I'll do a perf skim and the change list.

leah: I can take code review now, ping me if you need me to prioritize. What's the rollback plan if it fails canary?

maya: Rollback plan is the usual: immediate revert + autoscale back to previous pool. release-manager can confirm thresholds. CI flake is unrelated to core change (looks like network flake).

devops-bot: Deploy window starts 16:45 UTC. Canary set to 5% for 15m. Alerts: k8s/pod-restart >5 per min -> auto-rollout-back.

samir: There is a failing unit test on master in buildkite - looks like a transient fixture. I pushed a tiny retry in the test harness (branch: test-retry/8821). If reviewers okay we can merge that alongside the fix.

ashwin: Skim complete. Approve for correctness. left one comment about a log level (nit).

leah: Approving now. Left one optional suggestion. :thumbsup: 

maya: That's 2x LGTM — thanks! I'm going to queue the merge and hold at the merge-gate until CI is clean. If CI only has the macos flake we'll proceed at 16:32 UTC and tag for canary.

release-manager: Noted. I'll watch the canary metrics (latency, error-rate) and be ready to trigger rollback. Tagging @oncall for 16:45-17:05 monitoring window.

maya: Merge executed 16:33 UTC. Merge commit: abcdef3. CI rerun kicked off.

devops-bot: CI status: all green at 16:37 UTC. Canary rollout started 16:45 UTC. Monitoring dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/canary/8821

samir: Thanks everyone. If any anomalies ping here and we'll flip the rollback. :rocket:
